releaseNotes:
Meet **Twix**, Compass’s private meeting companion, turning conversations into locally processed transcripts with speaker identification and easy export.

## ✨ What's New

### 🎙️ Record Your Meetings

- Capture microphone and system audio using your selected devices.
- Stop a recording from the app or the system tray. Recordings and timing information are saved locally.
- Use the configurable consent reminder before recording. You remain responsible for obtaining consent from participants.

### 🗣️ Transcribe and Identify Speakers

- Turn recordings into speaker-labelled transcripts with local transcription and speaker identification.
- Review transcript text and edit speaker names.
- Cancel processing jobs and resume them after restarting the app.

### 📤 Keep and Share Your Notes

- Export transcripts as JSON, Markdown, text, or SRT.
- Delete a session from the app to remove its local audio and derived data.

### 🔐 Local Processing with Compass

- Download and verify a compatible processing model using a Compass API key. No personal Hugging Face account or token is required.
- Once a model is installed and verified, process recordings offline. There is no cloud transcription fallback.
- Recordings and transcripts stay local; Compass receives authentication and model-download metadata.

## ⚙️ Getting Started

- Twix supports Windows 10 and 11 on x64 computers.
- In **Settings**, save a Compass API key and download a model. Wait for **Offline ready** before processing a recording.
- See [Setup and diagnostics](setup-and-diagnostics.md) for model, hardware, local-data, and installer details.

🛸 Co-authored with [Nova](https://www.compassap.ai/nova)
